geographic_model: exact nominal Doppler, per-track CFO, per-NORAD rates fixed at zero
geographic_objective: cap-800 loss per session; equal session mean within group; frozen information weights across groups
transition_rule: translate at unchanged spacing while the winner is on the edge; proceed only after an interior winner

final_rate_audit.acceptance_rule: every selected-group rate fit converges, has zero effective-boundary rates, and passes direct exact SGP4 replay at 0.2 Hz

postseal_policy: the surveyed reference is introduced only after inference and qualification are sealed
